mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.category_id, r.file_name, r.file_path, r.file_size, r.md5, r.phash, r.audit_status, r.audit_msg, r.pay_amount, r.pay_time, r.time_source, r.remark, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM receipt_image r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.md5 = #{md5} AND r.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.file_name, r.phash, r.create_time, r.deleted FROM receipt_image r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.phash IS NOT NULL
SELECT , c.name AS category_name FROM receipt_image r LEFT JOIN receipt_category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipt_image (user_id, category_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, md5, phash, audit_status, audit_msg, pay_amount, pay_time, time_source, remark, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{md5}, #{phash}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditMsg}, #{payAmount}, #{payTime}, #{timeSource}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE receipt_image SET pay_amount = #{payAmount}, pay_time = #{payTime}, time_source = #{timeSource}, remark = #{remark}, audit_status = 1, audit_msg = '人工确认通过：金额与时间已补充', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE receipt_image SET category_id = #{categoryId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
